text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Man, I really want to see my little bro!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You really love him lots! I definitely
understand
where you're coming from.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The video you showed me of him
crawling about
the other day was very
cute.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, he's the cutest in the whole
universe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Since moving to the dorms my chances
of seeing
him have gone way down, so I
can't help but hug
him tight whenever
we do meet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I can see why you'd never want to let go
too.
Babies are just so squishy, and it
feels nice to just
hold them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You got that right! He's gonna get all
bulky when
he gets older, so now's my
only chance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're already assuming he's gonna bulk
up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well he is Ryan's little brother after all. I can't wait to see what kind of person he becomes.
